example.title: Knapp Ranch, glass-lined storage silo, 13168 450th Avenue

brief: Glass-fused steel oxygen-limiting silo of the 1970s, about 20 ft across and 60 ft high: dark navy-blue bolted steel rings with faint horizontal seams, a shallow blue domed roof, a small white maker's panel near the top (render as a plain white placard) and a galvanized fill pipe arcing up and over from the ground to the roof. It stands at the end of the long red gambrel barn on a hilltop farmstead ringed by a spruce windbreak, with gravel road and rolling pasture below.
